To quickly learn the basics of using Axure RP, check out our [Core training series](https://www.axure.com/support) as well.

In this introductory guide, you'll learn the basics of creating and sharing prototypes. You’ll learn about pages, widgets, and interactions. You'll also learn how to view your prototypes in a web browser and share them with Axure Cloud.

## Pages [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#pages "Direct link to Pages")

Axure RP files are organized into [pages](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/managing-pages), which you can manage in the **Pages** pane.

To add a page, click the **Add page** button at the top-right of the **Pages** pane.

Double-click a page's name in the **Pages** pane to open it on the canvas.

![](https://docs.axure.com/assets/images/pages-adding-deleting-naming-fbb08a690c63567d64357d73522c9775.png)

## The canvas [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#the-canvas "Direct link to The canvas")

The canvas is where you'll build your designs. You can work without boundaries, or you can set page dimensions based on the target device you're designing for.

![](https://docs.axure.com/assets/images/styling-pages-dimensions-3c3bb0e32db3d6e895cee50af9ab2ee1.png)

## Widgets [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#widgets "Direct link to Widgets")

You’ll build your designs using [widgets](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/organizing-widgets), which are organized into [libraries](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/widget-libraries) in the **Libraries** pane. Axure RP comes with four widget libraries pre-installed — **Default, Flow, Icons, and Sample UI Patterns** — but you can also create your own or add libraries created by your teammates.

![](https://docs.axure.com/assets/images/organizing-widgets-positioning-widgets-on-the-canvas-librariesHW-798cc45e12c7da6373f94b80d0c3dbc3.png)

To add a widget to the canvas, drag it from the **Libraries** pane. You can also use the options in [the **Insert** menu](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/shapes#the-insert-menu) to add text, images, and shapes.

To edit the text on a widget, double click it, or select it and press `ENTER`.

To [change the visual appearance of your widgets](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/styling-widgets), head over to the **Style** pane. Many properties like fill color and font are also located in the style toolbar along the top of the canvas for quick access.

## Interactions [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#interactions "Direct link to Interactions")

Once you have some widgets on the canvas, you can add interactivity to them in the **Interactions** pane.

### Link to another page [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#link-to-another-page "Direct link to Link to another page")

It's simple and quick to create links between pages in your prototype.

![](https://docs.axure.com/assets/images/getting-started-create-link1-c19f9b04cf09bfaa4fd0800e7f6bb264.png)

![](https://docs.axure.com/assets/images/getting-started-create-link2-188afa6ca234de00a06e48c707a0acc0.png)

1. In the **Pages** pane, add a new page. You should now have two pages, Page 1 and Page 2.

2. On Page 1, drag a button widget onto the canvas from the **Libraries** pane.

3. Select the button and click **Click or tap → Open link** in the **Interactions** pane.

4. Select **Page 2** in the list that appears and click **OK**.

5. Click the **Preview** button at the top-right of the UI to open the prototype in your web browser.

6. Click the button to go to Page 2.


### Showing and hiding widgets [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#showing-and-hiding-widgets "Direct link to Showing and hiding widgets")

You can also dynamically show and hide widgets on the page. Learn how in the [Hiding and showing widgets tutorial](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/tutorials/hide-show-widgets).

### Interactive style effects [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#interactive-style-effects "Direct link to Interactive style effects")

You can use [style effects](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/style-effects) to change a widget's visual appearance when it's moused over, clicked on, and more. Learn how in the [Interactive button tutorial](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/tutorials/interactive-button).

## Sharing your prototypes [​](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/getting-started-video/\#sharing-your-prototypes "Direct link to Sharing your prototypes")

When you're ready to show your work to your teammates and stakeholders, you can either [publish to Axure Cloud for free](https://docs.axure.com/axure-rp/reference/viewing-sharing-prototypes/#publish-to-axure-cloud), or to one of our [private hosting solutions with Axure Cloud for Business](https://www.axure.cloud/#business).

Click the **Share** button at the top-right of the UI and give your project a name and password. Then click **Publish** to get a shareable link to the hosted project.

![](https://docs.axure.com/assets/images/publishing1-21071c9a55f4359cdd08d11808d628e6.png)
